benefits.desc: You will occasionally run into old comrades, some of whom may need favors. If you perform a few celebrated martial deeds your old military outfit (or a new one) is likely to offer you an officer’s rank. You gain the free service of up to 8 guards. Your new commanders will occasionally give you objectives: you will be expected to act independently in order to achieve these objectives.

benefits.desc:
Roll 1d10, choose, or make up your own.

#### Soldier Connections
|d10|Connection|
|---|---|
|1|Your old commanding officer who still wants you to rejoin.|
|2|The commander who callously sent your unit into a slaughter.|
|3|Your shady war buddy who can get their hands on anything with no questions asked.|
|4|Your best friend who went missing on the battlefield.|
|5|The comrade who saved your life at the risk of their own.|
|6|The ghost who haunts you.|
|7|The superior officer you punched (for abusing civilians? For insulting your honor? For preventing you from looting?)|
|8|The scary experimental war construct you accompanied on a dangerous mission.|
|9|The golden-armored knight with ridiculously good teeth who was always giving inspiring speeches.|
|10|The enemy officer who captured you.|

#### Soldier Mementos
|d10|Memento|
|---|---|
|1|A broken horn, tooth, or other trophy salvaged from a monster's corpse.|
|2|A trophy won in a battle (a tattered banner, a ceremonial sword, or similar).|
|3|A gaming set.|
|4|A letter from your sweetheart.|
|5|An old wound that twinges in bad weather.|
|6|A letter you're supposed to deliver to a dead comrade's family.|
|7|A horrifying memory you can't escape.|
|8|A horned or plumed helmet.|
|9|The sword you broke over your knee rather than fight for those bastards another day.|
|10|A medal for valor.|

**Основные:** ВЫН + ЛОВ

| Навык | Оригинал | Базовый | Роль |
|---|---|---|---|
| Лазание | Climb | 40% | Преодоление препятствий и укреплений |
| Навигация | Navigate | 10% | Наземное ориентирование по картам и компасу |
| Огнестрельное оружие (выбрать) | Firearm (choose) | 00% | Владение штатным военным оружием |
| Оружие ближнего боя (выбрать) | Melee Weapon (choose) | Разное | Ближний бой штыками, ножами или шанцевым инструментом |
| Первая помощь | First Aid | 30% | Полевая медицинская помощь раненым товарищам |
| Драка | Brawl | 25% | Подготовка к рукопашному бою |
| Скрытность | Stealth | 10% | Бесшумное перемещение в зонах боевых действий |
| Стратегия | Strategy | 01% | Понимание тактических и стратегических операций |
| Тяжёлое оружие (выбрать) | Heavy Weapon (choose) | 00% | Управление расчётным и тяжёлым военным вооружением |
| Уклонение | Dodge | ЛОВ x2% | Уклонение от вражеского огня и взрывов |
